tools.name: convert_time
tools.description: Convert one city's local time into one or more other cities. Each city says whether that local date is a public holiday. The result includes a https://timeofmeeting.com link for a 60-minute meeting. Choose a different length with create_meeting_link.

tools.name: search_cities
tools.description: Find cities by name. Each city includes its id, time zone, and country. The query is not repeated.

tools.name: get_dst_changes
tools.description: List clock changes for one city. Defaults to the next year. Each change includes the local time and the ISO week and US week of that local date. The range can be at most 366 days. dst_changes still calls this tool.

tools.name: next_occurrence

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_meeting_link, get_holidays · Private data: find_best_meeting_time, create_meeting_link, get_holidays · Public sink: create_meeting_link, dst_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_meeting_link, get_holidays · Private data: find_best_meeting_time, create_meeting_link, get_holidays · Public sink: create_meeting_link, dst_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
